privacy.title: Privacy and Face Recognition
privacy.collectBody: Only a numeric face template (embedding). We never store your photo unless you give separate photo consent.
privacy.whyBody: To record your attendance at services automatically.
privacy.keepBody: Until you withdraw consent, or 12 months after your last visit, then it is deleted.
privacy.withdrawBody: Ask Abouna or a servant. Your face data is deleted immediately.
privacy.share: We never sell or share biometric data. This follows the Texas Capture or Use of Biometric Identifier Act.
